# Feedback and contributions

This repository hosts RitaCAD downloads, public user documentation and issue tracking. Application and RGK source remain private. Public contributions can improve documentation, report reproducible bugs and describe useful modeling workflows. Usage and redistribution are governed by the [download license terms](../LICENSE.md).

## Report a bug

Use the [bug report form](https://github.com/ivs-kartikeya/RitaCAD/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml). Include the release version, Windows version, exact steps, expected result and observed result. For rendering problems, add your GPU and driver version if known. If Windows or RitaCAD displays an error, include its full message.

A small native project or screenshot can help reproduce a problem. Issues and attachments are public: remove personal paths, credentials, confidential geometry and other private information before posting. Do not attach proprietary files you are not allowed to share.

Check [known limitations](../docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md) first. If the operation is unsupported, describe the desired workflow using the feature request form.

## Request an improvement

Use the [feature request form](https://github.com/ivs-kartikeya/RitaCAD/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml). Explain the task you want to complete, what currently gets in the way and the result you would consider useful. A simple example is more helpful than a broad request to match another CAD product.

## Improve documentation

Open an issue or a focused pull request for a correction to these public guides. Explain the affected page and the behavior you observed. Do not upload application source, RGK internals, internal reports, model weights or third-party material without permission.

Bug reports and feature requests help prioritize future work; a response or implementation date is not guaranteed.
